doctor.desc: check this machine has what Spiritus needs (changes nothing)

bootstrap.desc: re-run setup: requirements, `spiritus` command, PATH, modules: [--yes]

modules:list.desc: catalog + my modules, installed or not

modules:install.desc: install a standard module from the catalog: <name> [--ref R]

modules:add.desc: add my own module by git URL: <url> --kind daemon|domain [--name N] [--ref R]

modules:sync.desc: clone every module from modules.local.json that is missing

modules:update.desc: pull one / all modules, refresh their registry rows: [name]

modules:status.desc: every daemon / domain folder and its git state: [--fetch]

modules:remove.desc: delete a module folder, refuses to lose work: <name> [--force]
